title: Atlas distillation  all objects into the pane
thesis: The desk has moved OUT of the HUD and into the broader ecosystem. All surfaces now visible. The old pins (barry, tuebor, detroit, rico, brainbacks) are the OLDEST patterns  relics to unearth and solve, not dead zeros to display.

old_pins.note: These started the graph algo. They are archaeological now  the oldest patterns in the membrane.
